value.rationale: The full minimal-fort hypergraph (two families of triples plus paired quadruples) makes the complete zero forcing polynomial tractable and reveals a discontinuous structural effect from deleting just a perfect matching. It yields a family of fort-cover integrality gaps tending to 3, versus 2 for K_n,n, a natural LP-relaxation phenomenon motivated by the original fractional-zero-forcing paper; neither elementary scalar bounds nor prior known K_n,n computations recover the paired-fort census.
